title: Run Training Data Curator with its atomic selected gate
purpose: Implement the one indivisible Training Data Curator application command: strict provider-neutral invocation, advisory-only persistence for non-selected outcomes, and atomic selected-plus-curator_auto application over production-reachable multi-evidence state.
success_outcome: An explicit training_data_curator invocation uses only TrainingDataCuratorProviderRequestV1/DecisionV1. Deferred or rejected commits only the exact current-run advisory allowlist and returns advisory_ready/not_requested; silent commits no advisory and returns model_silent; every selected result that passes current guards and is accepted for application ends only as one advisory_ready/confirmed atomic commit of selected identity, curator_auto confirmation and derived can_train_on=true, or as a real policy_blocked rollback with no reusable selected advisory. Invalid, unbound/provider, pre/post-I/O guard, stale/duplicate-run, weak-evidence, gold, agent_labeled, archive/revoke, candidate-race, audit, and commit branches return their canonical outcome with zero partial lifecycle/trainability authority or generic MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI effect.
anti_goals: A new evidence source/HTTP/UI/trigger, direct model transition or field assignment, gold assignment, agent_labeled confirmation, generic MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI changes, provider selection, or inherited proof for dependency claims.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-013 RED: after TASK-055 the Dataset Governance Agent route works but training_data_curator has no registered strict request/result/application command; GREEN: deferred/rejected persist only the current-run advisory allowlist, silent persists nothing, selected cannot directly assign authority, and invalid/unbound/provider/current-guard/audit branches return their canonical outcome with zero forbidden effects; decisive comparison: exact fields, versions, events, provider calls and outcome matrix; artifact: focused deterministic/PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-057-T3-FT-014-W5/.

FT-014-AC-014 RED: after TASK-055 and the evidence/transition dependencies, no Training Data Curator application command can atomically consume a selected result, so a production-enriched strong-evidence candidate remains unconfirmed; GREEN: the exact current-run positive case commits selected identity, curator_auto confirmation and can_train_on=true together, while every accepted selected policy failure rolls the advisory and transition back and returns policy_blocked; decisive comparison: canonical rows/versions/events, outcome and provider calls; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-057-T3-FT-014-W5/.

FT-014-AC-014 negative matrix: GREEN weak/missing/distinct-kind/follow-up, stale/different run or candidate version, gold, agent_labeled, archive/revoke, audit failure and commit failure each preserve prior candidate/advisory state with zero partial authority; decisive comparison: exact error/outcome, row/event counts and safe rerun; artifact: adversarial gate transcript.
constraints: Use one explicit internal curator application command; no automatic source event, scheduler, page read, startup, or HTTP trigger.
Provider I/O stays outside transactions; after I/O one canonical lock order revalidates current authority, Plant, candidate version and exact run identity before advisory/gate writes.
Every schema-valid selected result is handled in this command; a result that passes current guards and reaches policy application may not stop at an intermediate runnable or reusable advisory branch.

Selected advisory, lifecycle transition, derived trainability and required event refs are one all-or-nothing PostgreSQL UoW; a policy failure rolls them all back and an appended event before commit failure is audit noise only.
invariants: Training Data Curator is advisory: model wording is never a policy input and the result cannot set confirmation_source, quality tier, split, evidence, or can_train_on directly.
curator_auto confirms only raw standard strong-evidence candidates and never gold or agent_labeled.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-013: strict curator request/result and complete outcome matrix over deferred/rejected/silent/selected, exact current-run fields and all-or-none/unique constraints, duplicate/stale run, audit and post-I/O race failures, unbound/no-fallback behavior, and static zero MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI/direct-authority proof.

FT-014-AC-014: production-created photo candidate plus record_outcome association plus selected curator success matrix with exact run/digest/version equality, atomic advisory/transition/events, and derived trainability.

FT-014-AC-014: isolated rollback-safe adversarial matrix for every weak/stale/gold/agent_labeled/current-authority/race/audit/commit branch, safe rerun, zero partial rows/events authority, and zero generic publication/device effects.
